orgDesign.companyProfile: Premium long-haul airline and travel company operating passenger retail, loyalty, holidays, partner connectivity, disruption-heavy airport operations, and cargo. The domain is modeled as focused teams of roughly 8-11 FTE plus lightweight group leadership.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Value-stream teams own guest, holiday, commercial, operations, and cargo outcomes while shared platform teams provide identity, payments, integration, data, and reliability capabilities reused across the portfolio.
designPrinciples: Separate guest retail, holidays, commercial distribution, operations recovery, and cargo because they have distinct customers, workflows, and economics.
Keep customer care and disruption recovery tightly linked to operations rather than hiding them in a generic support function.
Use shared platform teams only where reuse is structurally high: identity, payments, eventing, data, and resilience.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for distinct value streams and keep most groups to one or two teams.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
